data.name: Nairah
data.gender_notes: Nairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'an-Nā'irah' which means 'the radiant one'. Nairah is a name that symbolizes enlightenment, purity, and divine light. The name Nairah carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nairah usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light of spiritual enlightenment in Islam.
data.etymology: Nairah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nairah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Nairah holds deep significance. It embodies the concept of inner illumination, a metaphor for the soul's journey towards enlightenment. The name is believed to invoke God's divine blessings, guiding the individual toward the path of spiritual growth and self-realization. In the Islamic belief, enlightenment is not only a personal journey but also a collective one as individuals strive to realize their potentials and create a better world for all. The name Nairah is a constant reminder of the power of the divine light that resides within each individual, inspiring them to seek knowledge, practice good deeds, and spread love and peace in the world.
